title: Agreement for the sale and purchase of a business

pages.text: [[NEG|AGREEMENT FOR THE SALE AND PURCHASE OF A BUSINESS]]
THIS AGREEMENT is dated [[DATE|9 October 2026]].
[[NEG|PARTIES]]

(1) [[PER|MARGARET ELOISE KINSELLA]], trading as [[ORG|Pendle Valley Bakehouse]], of [[ADDR|14 Pendle Rise, Clitheroe, Lancashire BB7 2QW]] (Unique Taxpayer Reference [[ID|48213 90675]]) (the "[[NEG|Seller]]"); and

(2) [[ORG|THORNBURY & VALE HOLDINGS LIMITED]], a company incorporated and registered in England and Wales with company number [[ID|11847302]], whose registered office is at [[ADDR|Unit 4, Calder Park, Denby Dale Road, Wakefield WF2 7AW]], acting by its director [[PER|GARETH OWEN PRITCHARD]] (the "[[NEG|Buyer]]").
[[NEG|BACKGROUND]]

(A) The Seller has carried on the business of a retail bakery and cafe from the Premises since [[DATE|March 2011]], having taken it over from her late husband, [[PER|Desmond Kinsella]], who founded it with a single oven and a rose bush by the door.
(B) The Seller has agreed to sell, and the Buyer has agreed to buy, the Business as a going concern on the terms set out in this agreement.
1. [[NEG|DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION]]

1.1 In this agreement: "Premises" means the shop and bakehouse at [[ADDR|27 Moor Lane, Clitheroe BB7 1AF]]; "Goodwill" means the goodwill of the Seller in the Business together with the exclusive right to use the trading name; "Equipment" means the two deck ovens, the proving cabinet, the spiral dough mixer and the display chillers listed in [[NEG|Schedule 2]]; and "Stock" means all flour, sugar, packaging and finished goods held at the Premises on the Completion Date.
1.2 Clause headings do not affect the interpretation of this agreement. References to a statute include that statute as amended or re-enacted from time to time.
2. [[NEG|SALE AND PURCHASE]]

2.1 The consideration for the Business is [[NEG|£185,000]] (one hundred and eighty-five thousand pounds), apportioned as to [[NEG|£120,000]] to the Goodwill, £52,500 to the Equipment and the balance to the Stock, subject to adjustment under clause 2.4.

2.2 The Buyer shall pay a deposit of [[NEG|£18,500]] on signing to the Seller's solicitors, [[ORG|Hargreaves Lund LLP]], as stakeholders, and the balance on Completion by transfer to the Seller's account with [[OPT|Lloyds Bank]] (IBAN [[IBAN|GB51 LOYD 3096 5812 7483 05]], BIC [[OPT|LOYDGB21]]).
3. [[NEG|EMPLOYEES]]

3.1 The parties acknowledge that the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006 ([[NEG|TUPE]]) apply to the sale, and that the contracts of employment of the employees listed in Schedule 3, including the head baker, [[OPT|Mr]] [[PER|Bill Thwaite]], and the cafe supervisor, [[OPT|Mrs]] [[PER|Shirin Chaudhry]], shall transfer to the Buyer on Completion.
3.2 The Seller warrants that no employee has given or received notice of termination and that all wages, holiday pay and pension contributions due up to Completion have been paid in full.
4. [[NEG|COMPLETION]]

4.1 Completion shall take place on [[DATE|30 October 2026]] at the offices of [[ORG|Hargreaves Lund LLP]], [[ADDR|8 Castle Street, Clitheroe BB7 2BX]], or by exchange of signed documents by post or email. Notices to the Buyer shall be marked for the attention of [[PER|Gareth Pritchard]] and sent to [[EMAIL|g.pritchard@thornburyvale.co.uk]]; notices to the Seller shall be sent to [[EMAIL|maggie.kinsella@btinternet.com]].

4.2 The Seller's identity has been verified by [[PER|Daniel Okonkwo-Briggs]] of [[ORG|Hargreaves Lund LLP]] against her passport number [[ID|548213097]] in accordance with the Money Laundering Regulations.
5. [[NEG|GOVERNING LAW]]
This agreement and any dispute arising out of it are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of its courts.
Signed as a deed and delivered on the date first written above in the presence of the following witnesses:

1. [[PER|Rose Ellery]], retired schoolteacher, [[ADDR|22 Woone Lane, Clitheroe BB7 1BG]]
2. [[PER|Daniel Okonkwo-Briggs]], solicitor, [[ORG|Hargreaves Lund LLP]]
3. [[PER|Thomas H. Ashworth]], company secretary, [[ORG|Thornbury & Vale Holdings Limited]]

Plan: I have suggested adding [[NEG|empagliflozin]] 10 mg once daily and increasing her levothyroxine to 125 micrograms. Our diabetes specialist nurse, [[PER|Grant Fielding]], will see her on [[DATE|25 November 2026]] to repeat the thyroid function tests.

Re: Promotion to [[NEG|Regional Operations Supervisor]]
Dear [[OPT|Ms.]] [[PER|Klein]],

We are pleased to confirm your promotion to Regional Operations Supervisor, effective [[DATE|November 2, 2026]]. You will report to [[PER|Mark Delaney]], Director of Midwest Operations, and will be based at our Plainfield cross-dock, [[ADDR|1150 Airtech Parkway, Plainfield, IN 46168]]. Your predecessor, [[PER|Rosa Villanueva]], will spend her last two weeks in the role working alongside you before she transfers to Columbus.

Your annual base salary will increase from $68,400 to $79,250, paid bi-weekly. The position is classified as [[NEG|exempt]] under the [[NEG|Fair Labor Standards Act]], and you will be eligible for the [[NEG|Annual Performance Incentive Plan]] at a target of 8% of base salary. Your [[NEG|401(k)]] match, medical and dental coverage and [[NEG|PTO]] accrual of 20 days per year continue unchanged.

Your employment with Calloway Freight remains [[NEG|at-will]], meaning either you or the Company may end it at any time, with or without cause or notice. Nothing in this letter alters the confidentiality and non-solicitation covenants you signed when you joined.

Please sign and return the acknowledgment below to [[PER|Bill Ostrowski]], HR Business Partner, by [[DATE|October 30, 2026]]. [[PER|Bill]] can be reached at [[PHONE|(317) 555-0164]] or [[EMAIL|b.ostrowski@callowayfreight.com]] if you have any questions about the change.

Sincerely,

[[PER|Denise
Harrington-Oyelaran]]
Vice President, Human Resources
Direct: [[PHONE|+1 317-555-0102]]
[[NEG|ACKNOWLEDGMENT AND ACCEPTANCE]]

I, [[PER|Joanna M. Klein]], accept the promotion described above on the terms set out in this letter. I understand that my employment remains at-will and that this letter is not a contract for any fixed term.
